content: {"reasoning":"CO-97 is an adjudicated bundling denial, so duplicate clean submission, records submission, retro authorization, and patient billing would not properly address it. The payer offers peer-to-peer review, and similar claims succeeded 2/2 with peer-to-peer versus 0/9 with formal appeals. A peer-to-peer is therefore the strongest available route to overturn the denial and recover the allowed amount.","action":"request_peer_to_peer"}
